APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE TEK ELEONORA
Ofrohet per shitje nje apartament 2+1 i cili eshte i pozicionuar ne katin e 5 te nje ndertimi te ri me ashensor. Organizohet ne nje soxhorno spacioze,ambjent gatimi i vecuar. dy dhoma gjumi,nje tualet,nje ballkon me pamje te lire,dhe nje hapesire e cila mund te sherbej si zone argetimi. Ofrohet totalisht i mobiluar si ne foto dhe ne cmim eshte i perfshire dhe nje post parkimi. Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni.
description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN ELEONORA A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale, which is located on the 5th floor of a new building with an elevator. It is organized in a spacious living room, separate cooking area. two bedrooms, a bathroom, a balcony with a free view, and a space that can serve as an entertainment area. It is offered fully furnished as in the photo and the price includes a parking post. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me.
